title: Verify mastery: Support verified offline bootstrap and recovery
goal: VC-201-050 (P1) claims mastery of: Import a checksummed bundle of supported binaries, models, and extension metadata into an isolated host; a network-disabled drill boots, serves a local mission, and diagnoses missing artifacts without cloud fallback.. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: cloud egress is blocked while loopback stays available and a local engine remains selectable with the network disabled. Verified by `tests/airgap_mode.rs`: airgap_mode_blocks_cloud_egress_allows_loopback, airgap_mode_local_engine_name_still_selectable. Residual: importing a checksummed offline bundle into an isolated host, and diagnosing missing artifacts without cloud fallback, are not e. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_050_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence.
